messages:
maria: quick postmortem follow-up for recurring OOMs on kv-shard-4. goal = assign owners, set short timelines, and schedule a canary for fragmentation remediation. proposed items: light-weight profiling, heap-scan exports, soft_limit tuning, slab-defrag canary, runbook updates. thoughts?

arjun: I can own profiling. will run low-sample perf + jemalloc dumps and produce flamegraphs. commands I'll use: `perf record -F 200 -g -p $PID -- sleep 20` and `jeprof --alloc_objects`. will avoid heavy sampling in prod.

carmen: I will run the heap-scan and push artifacts to s3://redwood-debug/kv/3812345678/ by Thu EOD. will include fragmentation heatmap and per-slab histograms.

patrick: propose a temporary soft_limit bump 60%->66% on a small canary (8 nodes) for 24h to reduce eviction noise while we gather data. will gate behind feature flag and monitor evictions.

maria: tentative timeline: profiling by Wed noon (arjun), heap-scan Thu EOD (carmen), soft_limit canary Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC (patrick), runbook draft by Fri (carol+maria). retro next Tue.

carol: I'll update the runbook: add rollback steps, exact commands for `kv-evict`, slab-defrag stop, and how to revert `soft_limit`. will include dashboard snapshots and playbook checklist.

arjun: quick note—local replay shows long-lived allocations in EncodeBulk and LRU promotion. sample log snippet: `2026-03-23T03:11:05Z kv_alloc shard=4 size=131072 site=EncodeBulk residency_ms=1.5e6`. will upload full traces.

carmen: slab stats show many small free chunks but high RSS -> fragmentation likely. I'll add per-slab free/used CSV.

patrick: if fragmentation confirmed, schedule slab-defrag vacuums on 2 canary nodes first. need SRE signoff for maintenance window.

maria: make canary window Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC. carol, can you coordinate with oncall and add approval to runbook?

carol: yes, I'll ping oncall and add the window plus rollback steps: 1) revert soft_limit 2) abort slab-defrag 3) scale down canary nodes.

arjun: will upload perf artifacts and flamegraphs here when ready; sharing jemalloc knobs to keep sampling light.

patrick: alerting suggestion: add `ghost_residency_delta` with 5m/30m windows and page P2 if delta >500MB. I'll open the PR.

maria: owners recap: profiling=arjun, heap-scan=carmen, soft_limit canary=patrick, runbook=carol+maria, alerting=patrick. cadence: biweekly 30m check owned by Maria.

carol: follow-up action: add a weekly job to post residency-growth CSV to /alerts/kv-residency and tag owners. will calendar it.

arjun: note: keep perf sampling conservative in prod; I'll post exact flags.

carmen: heap-scan uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv/3812345678/heap-scan.tar.gz :link:

sre-bot: runbook draft created: https://docs.redwood.io/runbooks/kv-defrag-playbook-draft 1 comments.

maria: please add one-line status updates here as you finish items so I can convert them into tracked actions.

arjun: perf artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv/3812345678/perf.tar.gz  will annotate flamegraphs tomorrow.

patrick: canary staged, will flip flag at 2026-03-27T02:00Z and monitor for 4h; will post results.

carmen: heap-scan CSV flagged suspect sites: EncodeBulk and LRU promotion hotspots.

maria: closing loop for now. retro next Tue to choose long-term fixes (quotas, allocator tweaks, GC/defrag ops). thanks team. :thumbsup:
